title: Grokking Can Be Steered: Selecting Desirable Solutions By Choice Of Learning Rule
abstract: arXiv:2611.19477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: During grokking, a network transitions from memorization to generalization, yet what shapes the neural implementation (circuit) of the generalizing solution and specifically the number of participating neurons (its size) remains unclear. We find that the learning rule, the combination of credit assignment algorithm and optimizer, controls this: On modular addition, every learning rule we study that groks recovers the same Fourier-based algorithm, yet implemented by circuits that differ in size. Why? A neuron stays in use when its credit is large relative to the non-gradient term of its own update, and this single condition unifies three routes to unused neurons: the coupled weight decay, Adam's $\epsilon$ and the decay of a trainable per-neuron gain. translated_title: 顿悟可以被引导：通过选择学习规则来选取理想的解
translated_abstract: 在顿悟过程中，网络会从记忆过渡到泛化，然而是什么塑造了泛化解的神经实现（电路），特别是参与神经元的数量（即电路规模），仍不清楚。我们发现学习规则——即信用分配算法与优化器的组合——控制着这一点：在模加法任务上，我们研究的每一种能够发生顿悟的学习规则都恢复了相同的基于傅里叶的算法，但其实现电路的规模各不相同。为什么？当一个神经元的信用相对于其自身更新中的非梯度项较大时，该神经元会继续被使用，这一单一条件统一了导致神经元不被使用的三条路径：耦合的权重衰减、Adam 的 $\epsilon$ 以及可训练的逐神经元增益的衰减。均衡分配给每个神经元的信用大小，或根据每个神经元的信用来缩放其权重衰减，可以扩大有效电路的规模（从输出权重测量），从……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现学习规则（信用分配算法与优化器的组合）决定了顿悟后网络泛化解电路的规模，并提出通过均衡各神经元的信用或按信用缩放权重衰减来引导网络形成更大规模的有效电路。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the choice of learning rule (the combination of credit assignment algorithm and optimizer) determines the size of the circuit implementing the generalizing solution during grokking, and that equalizing per-neuron credit or scaling each neuron's weight decay by its credit can steer networks toward larger effective circuits.
